Name: Water
Description: The amount of water in headwaters. Higher values can create larger rivers.

Name: Width
Description: The width of the rivers. High values create wide rivers, with somewhat wide tributaries. Low values create thin rivers with thin tributaries.

Name: Depth
Description: The depth of the rivers. This value is independent of Downcutting.

Name: Downcutting
Description: Like with the Erosion node, Downcutting decides how deeply the river should cut into rock and soil while moving forward.

Name: Headwaters
Description: The number of headwaters from which rivers can start. Not all will become rivers, but rather tributaries that feed the main river.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.
